scripts.dev: npm run build -w @spot-the-song/shared && concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @spot-the-song/client" "npm run dev -w @spot-the-song/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @spot-the-song/shared && npm run build -w @spot-the-song/server && npm run build -w @spot-the-song/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @spot-the-song/shared && npm run typecheck -w @spot-the-song/shared && npm run typecheck -w @spot-the-song/server && npm run typecheck -w @spot-the-song/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @spot-the-song/shared && npm run test -w @spot-the-song/shared && npm run test -w @spot-the-song/server
